feature: Admin E2-B: Event edit lineup chips (matched, unsure, typed) and Add an artist
note: Boards: design_handoff_admin_redesign/boards/06-events-artists-prices/event-edit (desktop) and event-edit-mobile (phone); B+ addendum 5 04/past-show-d for the same field on a played show. CONTACT_SHEET_ROLE=admin. Read-only: types into Add an artist but never presses Save. The editor reads GET /v1/admin/events/:id on the SERVER, so the chips come from the scratch Neon fixture Violet Grohl (6cacabc9-...), as in admin-4b-2d-pickers. For all three tints in one cell, give that show a bill with a matched artist, an artist whose match_status is 'ambiguous' (amber) and a name with no artist row (neutral). By hand: Delete on a focused chip removes it, Alt+arrow moves it, and a failed Save (stop the API) snaps the bill back with 'The lineup is as it was.'
